question: #11308: does the briefed agent keep its result on other engines? B0 (Claude) against the same briefing and verify on OpenCode with GLM-5.2 on Vertex (Bopencode) and Gemini 3.1 Pro on Vertex through OpenCode (Bgemini), on S2's issues; A (bare Claude Code) comes from S2's published rows.
issue_selection: the 21 issues of plans/s2.json (validated before any S2 result); none dropped after results

arms_not_run.Bcodex: the owner's ChatGPT login answers 'You've hit your usage limit ... try again at Oct 18th' (checked on oa-dev-env-21 before freezing); no other Codex login without a paid key. Deferred to a separate frozen plan once the login answers; dropped before any trial, not after results.

order: issues in a seeded random order; per issue each rep rotates the arm order from a seeded start. Run as AB_SHARD=i/3 on three identical machines (the seeded orders match the unsharded run).

pins.agent_source: crates/briefed-agent at 616c6f79d0 (origin/main), cargo build --release on each environment (same hash on each)
pins.host: oa-dev-env-21, -22, -23 (GCE c3-standard-22 spot, 300 GB, cloned from oa-dev-env-4's disk), one shard each, AB_HOST=local, prewarm per issue, 600 s per command, hidden tests 300 s
pins.logins: Claude: the owner's subscription token (dev-env-session.sh); OpenCode/Gemini: the VM's service account on Vertex AI (application default credentials); OPENROUTER_API_KEY unset for the run

outcome: accepted = the fix commit's own tests pass on the change (remote/eval.sh) AND the blind judge accepts (score >= 4). Never from the agent's own report.

analysis.primary: success difference (arm - B0) with a 95% CI from 10000 issue-level bootstrap resamples (seed 11211), before cost; each arm also against S2's A
analysis.cost: $ per accepted: Claude and OpenCode report list-price cost (OpenCode: its own list-price cost for the Vertex model)
analysis.time: median and p90 wall time per arm
analysis.decision: an engine arm 'matches or beats B0' only if its success CI's lower bound is above -0.05 AND its cost per accepted is lower than B0's with the reduction CI's lower bound above 0. The default engine of work_issue.py / openagents chat work changes from briefed Claude only if an arm meets that rule; otherwise the default stays and the arm is reported as not shown.

harness_failures: a trial that hits its login's usage limit is discarded and rerun when the login answers; nothing else is rerun or excluded.
